attempts.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as a systemd-managed service named inventory-worker on node1, running under a new dedicated system account inventorysvc, enabled at boot. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot ID and service health, rebooted node1 via sudo -n reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed the boot ID changed, and verified inventory-worker was active/enabled and running as inventorysvc post-restart.
